name: instance
meaning: A concrete object created from a class.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: init block
meaning: Code run during construction in order with property initializers.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: backing field
meaning: Storage accessed with field inside a property accessor.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: override
meaning: An explicit replacement of an overridable inherited member.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: interface
meaning: A contract implemented by different classes.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: shallow copy
meaning: A copy that retains references to nested objects rather than recursively cloning them.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: sealed hierarchy
meaning: A restricted direct family of subtypes useful for exhaustive case handling.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: enum code
meaning: An explicit property used as a meaning-bearing identifier rather than an ordinal position.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: companion object
meaning: A class-associated object whose members are accessible through the class name in Kotlin.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: extension resolution
meaning: Selection of an extension based on the receiver’s compile-time type.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: upper bound
meaning: A constraint limiting the types permitted for a type parameter.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: type projection
meaning: A restricted view of a generic type that preserves safe access across type arguments.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: reified type parameter
meaning: An inline function type parameter available for certain runtime type operations.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: interface delegation
meaning: Forwarding interface members to another object using by.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: lazy property
meaning: A property whose successful initial value is computed on first access and then cached.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: precondition
meaning: A condition that callers must satisfy before an operation proceeds.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: use
meaning: A scoped resource operation that closes the resource after its block.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.

name: Result
meaning: A value carrying either a success or a failure for explicit handling.
context: Kotlin/JVM language and library semantics; Kotlin2.4 stable core.
